Lemony Chicken and Feta Meatball Soup

Yield: 4 servings

Ingredients
- 1 pound ground chicken or turkey
- ½ cup crumbled feta
- ¾ cup rolled oats, divided
- 1 small red onion (½ diced, and ½ grated, then squeezed dry)
- ⅓ cup packed fresh dill, finely chopped
- 1 tablespoon ground cumin
- ½ teaspoon plus 1 tablespoon ground turmeric
- Kosher salt and black pepper
- 3 tablespoons olive oil
- ½ teaspoon red-pepper flakes, plus more for serving
- 4 cups low-sodium chicken broth or water
- 4 packed cups baby spinach
- 2 lemons (1 juiced, 1 cut into wedges)

Preparation
1. In a medium bowl, combine chicken, feta, ¼ cup oats, the grated onion, most of the dill (reserve about 2 tablespoons for garnish), cumin, ½ teaspoon turmeric and 1 teaspoon salt. Combine gently (hands work best) without overworking the meat. With wet hands, shape into about 25 balls, 1½ inches each. This makes enough for four.
2. Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium until shimmering. Cook the diced onion with a little salt for about 2 minutes, until it begins to soften. Add 1 tablespoon turmeric and the red-pepper flakes, stirring about 30 seconds until fragrant. Nestle the meatballs in the pot, pushing the onions to the sides. Brown the meatballs for 5 to 7 minutes, until golden on two sides.
3. Pour in the broth and the remaining ½ cup oats, tilting the pot to distribute them without disturbing the meatballs. Bring to an active simmer over medium-high, seasoning with salt. Simmer about 4 minutes, stirring gently, until the oats have softened and the meatballs are cooked through.
4. Stir in the spinach and the lemon juice for about 2 minutes, until wilted. Adjust the seasoning to taste. Ladle into bowls, topping each with black pepper, the remaining 2 tablespoons dill, lemon wedges and more red-pepper flakes.
